title: Three Days and One Short Map
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：tourist　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tourist 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the guide ① guided the tourist that no traveller in the valley would have recorded, and he said the guiding was the whole of the day. The ② tourist, meaning the visitor itself and not the map, ran three days and stayed unrecorded in the book; a tourist, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ tourist in that valley had the same short map beside it, and the ④ tourist at the far ledge, meaning the mark they kept for the children to find and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A tourist, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the guide said the recording is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the tourist was the whole of the matter, meaning the curiosity and not the visitor. The ⑥ tourist, meaning the curiosity and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; tourist, he said, is either something you guide or the only word that means both a visitor and a curiosity. He said the curiosity is the part they remember.

By 1983 the ⑦ tourist had become a line in a guidebook, and the guidebook had become an argument about the short map. The ⑧ tourist of the whole thing, the guide wrote in July, was one valley and three days of recording; tourist, he said, is either the mark at the far ledge or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ tourist I remember is the visitor recorded in the guidebook, which closed in 1985 and is still recorded as the quietest in the valley. A ⑩ tourist, my mother said in 1987, is the only visitor that improves by being recorded; every tourist, she said, is a curiosity that has agreed to look like a visitor. She said the curiosity was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 游客（指山谷里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 游客（指那位游客本身，与小小的地图相对）
C. 固定搭配：guide the tourist 带这一位游客
D. n. 游客（指留给孩子们找的那一处）
E. n. 游客之事（抽象总称，指一处山谷的游客之事）
F. n. 游客（指旅行手册里写到、被记载的那一位）
G. n. 游客、好奇（指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 好奇（抽象总称，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: guided the tourist that no traveller in the valley would have recorded
The tourist, meaning the visitor itself and not the map
the tourist at the far ledge
the tourist was the whole of the matter
the tourist had become a line in a guidebook
The tourist of the whole thing
A tourist, my mother said in 1987

answers.why: guide the tourist 意为“带这一位游客”，1978 年那位向导把山谷里没有一位旅人肯记载的一位游客做了一遍。
tourist 意为“游客”，指那位游客本身而不是小小的地图，它经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被记载。
tourist 意为“游客”，指山谷里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一张小小的地图。
tourist 意为“游客”，指最远那处崖台的留给孩子们找的那一处，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
tourist 意为“游客、好奇”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位好奇就是那件事的全部。
tourist 意为“好奇”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位游客，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
tourist 意为“游客”，指旅行手册里写到、被记载的那一位，到 1983 年这一位成了旅行手册里的一行。
tourist 意为“游客之事”，向导七月写道，整件事的游客之事是一处山谷和三个日子的记载。
tourist 意为“游客”，我记得的是旅行手册里记载过的那一位，1985 年走完了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一位。
tourist 为抽象总称，母亲 1987 年说，游客是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的游客。
